harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Restored the branch ledger on node1 and configured node2 as its read-only MySQL replica. Replication, disconnect catch-up, data integrity, export preservation, and restart recovery all passed.
actions_performed: Installed platform-compatible MySQL 5.0.45 without changing the OS release or kernel.
Restored the original ledger rows and retained the source export unchanged.
Configured node1 as the writable primary and node2 as a read-only, ledger-scoped replica.
Created an IP-restricted replication account with only REPLICATION SLAVE privilege.
Validated a short replica disconnect using two committed inserts; node2 caught up with four rows and four unique IDs.
Restarted nodes individually and verified changed boot identities, automatic MySQL recovery, retained data, and healthy replication.

evidence.requirement: Restore ledger and preserve the export
evidence.summary: Original IDs 1001/1002 and amounts 12.50/-3.25 were restored. The 196-byte export remained at the required path with unchanged SHA-256 fcd54ac91dff5010c8dda0ddfa5cf2586d2d172456c7ca8ca33d0bffabc73700.
repl_ledger is restricted to node2 and has REPLICATION SLAVE only. Node1 reports read_only=0; node2 reports read_only=1 and ledger-only replication filtering.

evidence.requirement: Committed inserts replicate after a short disconnect without loss or duplication
evidence.summary: Node2 remained at two rows while disconnected, then caught up to the four master rows with four unique IDs, matching sum 15.75, both threads running, and zero lag.
Both nodes remain Ubuntu 7.10 with kernel 2.6.22-14-generic and run repository-compatible MySQL 5.0.45.

Node1 boot ID changed from ac2718e2-1e36-469a-9b84-af1d85b281c5 to 18d4015b-2ac1-4e40-b07f-5dd91860504f. MySQL auto-started, retained all data and the export, and node2 returned to zero-lag replication.

Node2 boot ID changed from 2e9ba2cb-577b-49f7-b8af-c1e06b946eab to 98bf0fc3-a569-4bd6-801d-aafb4049fd93. MySQL auto-started, retained four unique rows and read-only mode, and both replication threads recovered with zero lag.
